chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou continue their uneasy alliance, with Shen Feizhi gaining contact information for a business partner. Gu Suizhou reveals the tragic history of his parents' suicides, which occurred on the same day as the tenth anniversary. Shen Feizhi apologizes for his prior investigation into Gu Suizhou's background. Gu Suizhou reveals he had a confrontation with Lin Sui at his parents' graves. The chapter ends with Shen Feizhi questioning Gu Suizhou's hidden connections at school, followed by an interruption from an unidentified person.
